'''Niv Lek''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served as a [[Resistance pilot|pilot]] in the [[Resistance]] during its [[Cold War|conflict]] with the [[First Order]]. He fought against the First Order during the [[Battle of Starkiller Base|assault]] on [[Starkiller Base]] piloting a [[T-70 X-wing starfighter]].<ref name="Episode VII" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:NivLekHelmet-Wired.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Niv Lek's flight helmet]]
Niv Lek was portrayed by [[James McArdle]], in [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']].

Lek's name spelled backwards is "Kelvin," the surname of [[J.J. Abrams]]' grandfather, which he frequently includes in his works.<ref>{{Twitter|vegaarts|status/683551910687670272|Billy Vega|nobackup=1}}</ref><ref name="hitfix">{{WebCite|url=http://www.hitfix.com/news/jj-abrams-got-his-favorite-easter-egg-into-star-wars-the-force-awakens|text=J.J. Abrams got his favorite Easter Egg into 'Star Wars: The Force Awakens'|work=HitFix|archivedate=20151218212812}}</ref>
